cases.name: Maegan Stormy Talbert
cases.about: Her obituary said. "Maegan had a unique flair for life. Her wardrobe, including her lipstick, was all in a variety of shades of black, her favorite color. She was a licensed cosmetologist and loved making others beautiful. She was a hard, dedicated employee at Ulta and State Beauty Supply in Benton. Maegan’s love for make-up and hair styling began at an early age when she and her grandmother, Velva, would cut and style her dolls’ hair, and Maegan would practice her make-up techniques on her grandmother. Maegan had a good sense of humor and was always “styling”.  Maegan’s dogs, Peaches and Wario, were very special to her. She recently added a new tattoo, “Hocus Pocus”, to her collection of which she was very proud of."
